notes.title: New events and missions
notes.content: Added merchant, camps and hidden mine events. Add new missions and many many more.

notes.title: New technologies, research tech with trait points, optimization and many more
notes.content:
Modular onboarding. It’s now a more exploration-based experience, delivering smaller portions of information. Several bugs were also fixed.
Locked technologies are now visible on the tech tree.
You can now learn 1 technology before starting game, using trait points (available from level 3).
Added kiln burning and overdrive technologies.
Music now changes dynamically as gameplay progresses (this will be expanded further).
Optimization – the game is now 400MB smaller.
Fixed enemies sometimes not attacking.
Balance changes – bricks and clay are more important; materials in the city are cheaper to buy.
Styling and asset enhancements.

notes.title: Version 0.5.0 is live
notes.content:
Version 0.5.0 is live
Changes:
- Game became harder
- run tasks gives much more experience
- added caravan size penalty
- some techs are easier to research
- more attaacks
- mine transport can be attacked in all missions (applies for mines with over 250 distance)
- endgame items are much more profitable
- task preview
